title: API/schema compatibility and idempotency
problem: Local passing callers can hide breaking external contracts.
rationale: Product API/schema changes require evidence/review; no silent breaking change because all callers in one repo pass.
applicability: Changed external API, schema, serialization or retry/idempotency behavior.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: existing contract/schema/serialization/upgrade tests and approved compatibility tool; new behavior exercises retry/idempotency where applicable.
target_check.reviewer: observable API contracts, consumers and removal plans.
target_check.limits: **D:** existing contract/schema/serialization/upgrade tests and approved compatibility tool; new behavior exercises retry/idempotency where applicable. **R:** observable API contracts, consumers and removal plans.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Product API/schema changes require evidence/review; no silent breaking change because all callers in one repo pass.

expected_evidence: **D:** existing contract/schema/serialization/upgrade tests and approved compatibility tool; new behavior exercises retry/idempotency where applicable. **R:** observable API contracts, consumers and removal plans.
repair: Preserve or version the external contract and add serialization/upgrade/retry/idempotency tests for affected consumers. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.

delivered_coverage.reason: DH-M1 supplies descriptor references only; guidance installation, runner and target check coverage are not delivered.
